name: Nam Illam
subtitle: Pantry, shopping & home
promotional_text: New in 3.0: Apple Watch, one-line Quick Add, Siri, repeating tasks and receipts that check their own totals. Private, offline and on your device.
description:
A little order. More room for living.

Nam Illam ("our home" in Tamil) brings everyday household life into one calm place on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch: what is in your kitchen, what to buy, what you spent and what is coming up.

YOUR DAY, IN FOCUS
Today shows the tasks, shopping and pantry items that need attention, with a short brief of what is due, what to buy and what was spent.

ADD SEVERAL THINGS AT ONCE
Type or say one line such as "Costco Saturday, milk, 2 dozen eggs, change the filter, $45 gas yesterday". Nam Illam splits it into shopping items, a task, a plan and an expense, and shows them for review before anything is saved.

ON YOUR WRIST
The Apple Watch app shows your shopping list by aisle and today's tasks. Tick items off in the store, finish tasks and add things by voice. Watch face and Smart Stack widgets show what is left to buy and your next task. Your iPhone keeps the list; the watch catches up when it reconnects.

SIRI AND SHORTCUTS
Ask Siri to add to your shopping list, add a task or an expense, or read out what you need.

SHOPPING THAT REMEMBERS
Keep one shared list with stores, quantities and who is buying, sorted in the order you walk the store. Buy again suggests the things your household usually rebuys by now. Nothing is added until you tap Add.

TASKS THAT REPEAT
Set tasks for every day, every week or every Sunday, assign them to someone and see them grouped by overdue, today, this week and later.

A PANTRY THAT SORTS ITSELF
Add what you have and Nam Illam files it into rice and grains, produce, dairy, spices and more, with a clear icon for each item. Track amounts, low stock and the expiry dates you enter.

RECEIPTS, MADE READABLE
Scan a receipt and review the store, date, items and total before anything is saved. Short printed labels become readable names. Nam Illam checks the items against the receipt's own totals and tells you when something does not add up, so you can tick only the lines you trust.

SPENDING AT A GLANCE
Record purchases as expenses, see a one-line month summary and get a gentle flag for possible duplicate charges.

PLAN WHAT TO COOK
Explore meal ideas from what is already in your pantry and add missing ingredients to shopping.

SHARE WHEN YOU CHOOSE
Share your home with family through iCloud. Send chosen appointments to Apple Calendar and connect a selected Apple Reminders list if you want to.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Core household records work offline, with no Nam Illam account. Receipt reading, sorting and suggestions run on your device, and every suggestion waits for you to accept it. On-device intelligence depends on your device, iOS version and Apple Intelligence settings; manual entry always works.

Please review scanned receipt details before saving and check ingredient labels and allergens yourself. Expiry dates are records you enter, not a food-safety assessment. Meal and AI suggestions can be incomplete or incorrect. iCloud sharing needs compatible Apple accounts and available iCloud storage. The Apple Watch app needs the iPhone app.
whats_new:
Nam Illam 3.0: smarter, and now on Apple Watch.
• Apple Watch: your shopping list by aisle and today's tasks on your wrist. Tick off items, finish tasks and add by voice. Watch face and Smart Stack widgets show what's left.
• Add several things at once: one line becomes shopping, tasks, plans and expenses, shown for review.
• Siri: add to shopping, add a task or an expense, or hear what you need.
• Tasks repeat (every day, week or Sunday), can be assigned to someone, and are grouped by when they're due.
• Shopping follows the store's aisles and understands amounts like "2 dozen eggs".
• Expenses pick a category for you, sum up the month in one line and flag possible duplicates.
• Receipts check items against the printed totals, fix a clearly misread digit, and let you tick only the lines you trust.
• New midnight blue dark mode.
• Meal prep reminders have Mark done and Snooze buttons.
• Fixes and performance improvements.
